design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g. deep teal) for rules and table headers.
Render the financials table with hairline rules and right-aligned numbers.
Place the pull-quote in a large serif italic, set off by a top rule.
Industry snapshot as a stat strip with three numbers, growth bars, and a split bar, all in the accent colour.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: Specialty chemicals are formulated for a specific job rather than sold as a generic commodity.
industry_snapshot.growth_bars_label: Specialty chemicals growth — historical vs projected
industry_snapshot.rationale: The industry section is dense with market-size and growth figures; a snapshot makes them scannable.
industry_snapshot.split_bar_note: SMEs hold 70–75% of the market, leaving only a quarter to organised players.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Customer concentration is high. The top 10 customers accounted for around 59% of revenue from operations in FY2015, 57% in FY2016 and 59% in FY2017.[^drhp-p128] Export markets named in the filing are Nigeria, Saudi Arabia and Sri Lanka.[^drhp-p128]
pull_quotes.quote: The top 10 customers accounted for around 59% of revenue from operations in FY2015, 57% in FY2016 and 59% in FY2017.
pull_quotes.rationale: A single sharp number that captures the concentration risk better than any prose.

sidebars.body_markdown: The company is listing on NSE EMERGE, the SME platform of the National Stock Exchange.[^drhp-p75] The stated objects are to fund a new plant at GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, cover general corporate purposes, and create a public market for its shares.[^drhp-p75] The lead manager is Vivro Financial Services Private Limited; the registrar is Link Intime India Private Limited.[^drhp-p54][^drhp-p55] The offer size, the fresh-issue versus offer-for-sale split, any selling shareholder and the price band are not disclosed in the extracted pages.[^drhp-p75]
sidebars.rationale: Pulls together the offer mechanics — platform, objects, intermediaries, and what is missing — into one scannable block.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: Revenue from operations by period and EBITDA are not in the extracted statements; debt levels are not given either.
tables.rationale: The core financial trend — a small but real turnaround — is best scanned as a table, not prose.
tables.title: Restated financial summary
